risks.title: No PostgreSQL backup
risks.description: PostgreSQL databases clawdb and openclaw have no automated backup. A disk failure or database corruption would result in permanent loss of trade history, approval logs, and operational data.
risks.current_mitigation: Trading agents also write to JSONL flat files (partial redundancy for trades only)
risks.recommended_mitigation: pg_dump nightly cron to ~/backups/ + periodic off-machine copy

risks.title: Secrets single point of failure
risks.description: All 40 API keys and credentials are stored in a single .env file with no backup. Loss of this file (disk failure, accidental deletion) would take down all services requiring authentication.
risks.recommended_mitigation: Encrypted backup to macOS Keychain + 1Password vault. Separate secrets per capability.

risks.title: 3 PM2 processes in crash loop (DEGRADED)
risks.description: Three PM2 processes have accumulated high restart counts and are currently stopped. They may attempt restart and consume resources or produce error logs.
risks.recommended_mitigation: Investigate root cause. Either fix and restart or permanently delete from ecosystem if deprecated.

risks.title: n8n has 0 workflows — automation dead
risks.description: n8n is running but has 0 configured workflows. MEMORY.md references n8n as the routing layer for approved outputs, but no routing is active. Approved outputs are not being dispatched.
risks.recommended_mitigation: Configure n8n workflows for: (1) Telegram approval routing, (2) email dispatch, (3) BLCO outreach draft delivery

risks.title: Trading capital at risk — $1.55 Kalshi free balance
risks.description: Kalshi free balance is only $1.55 with ~$80 in 9 open positions. CashClaw Director needs minimum $5 balance to trade. If positions settle unfavorably, director will be halted by low-balance guard.
risks.current_mitigation: Low-balance guard ($5 minimum), daily spend cap $10, trading sentinel monitoring
risks.recommended_mitigation: Monitor position settlement dates, be ready to deposit if needed

risks.title: AGENTS.md has stale PM2 IDs
risks.description: AGENTS.md documents PM2 IDs that don't match live reality (e.g., lists alusi-gateway as id=2, actual is id=1). Also missing ids 16-22 and 25-28 which are online.
risks.current_mitigation: Documented as DEFECT-001 in Gate A register (non-blocking)
risks.recommended_mitigation: Update AGENTS.md with live PM2 topology after B3 registry is authoritative

risks.title: PM2 startup not verified — processes may not auto-restart on reboot
risks.description: If the Mac Mini reboots (power outage, macOS update), PM2 processes will not automatically restart unless `pm2 startup` was configured and `pm2 save` was run. This is unverified.
risks.current_mitigation: Tailscale SSH allows remote restart if detected
risks.recommended_mitigation: Verify `pm2 startup` configuration. Run `pm2 save`. Test by simulating restart.

risks.title: Port conflict: nexus-dashboard and open-empire-nexus both on 4444
risks.description: lsof shows both Python PID 762 and node binding to port 4444. Possible explanation: Python binds to 127.0.0.1:4444, node binds to 0.0.0.0:4444. If actual conflict exists, one service may be failing silently.
risks.current_mitigation: Both processes reported online by PM2
risks.recommended_mitigation: Verify with `lsof -iTCP:4444` — check actual addresses. Assign distinct ports if needed.

risks.title: No GitHub Actions CI/CD — 6 UA4200 repos unguarded
risks.description: All 6 UA4200 GitHub repos have been deployed but no GitHub Actions workflows exist. Direct pushes to main are not protected by CI validation or governance checks.
risks.recommended_mitigation: Add GitHub Actions workflows per B5 plan: validate.yml, deploy.yml, governance-check.yml

risks.title: Polymarket US balance $0.06 — trader effectively halted
risks.description: Polymarket US free balance is $0.06, with $39.94 in 13 open positions (settlement Sept-Nov 2026). Trader is effectively halted — cannot place new trades until positions settle or deposit is made.
risks.current_mitigation: Daily spend cap $10 enforced. Positions are locked, not at immediate risk.
risks.recommended_mitigation: Await position settlement (Sept-Nov 2026) or make targeted deposit

summary.note: No risk identified as a Track B blocker. All risks are operationally manageable with the current mitigation posture.
